verdict.rationale: Server-side session moderation is a fair question for a real-time communications platform, so the axis applies. The pack's only REST API mention covers project creation and usage numbers, not listing channels, muting or removing participants, or ending sessions. No evidence shows Agora delivers this story.

support.subject: As a developer, a server-side API lets me list sessions, mute or remove participants, and end a session without a client in the loop
